title: After its default bin is deleted, turning tracking on marks the remaining bin
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two bin locations for this test, bin location A and bin location B, at the test location.
  • Create an untracked part, part A, for this test with 0 in bin location A, marked Default, and 5 in bin location B.
  • Delete bin location A in Bin Locations (Settings, then Parts, then Bin Locations) while part A holds 0 there.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Inventory section lists only bin location B, with 5, and it is not marked Default; bin location A is gone.

Step 2:

  • Bin location B, the first bin row, is now marked Default; its quantity is still 5.

Step 3:

  • The window closes with no bin error.
  • Part A's Total Qty shows 5 Available, and Bin Location / Quantity shows bin location B with 5.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 35 (edited 27 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-E2: “A part reaches S5-R8 with bin locations and no default in two ways: the bin location that was its default is deleted in Settings → Parts → Bin Locations while the part holds 0 there, or an untracked part is saved with bin locations and none marked default.”
  • S5-R8: “In the part dialog, when the user turns tracking on and the part has bin locations but none is the default, the dialog marks the first one as the default.”

From: Product's answers to questions 13 to 27 (Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, Google Doc https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pkAPGqWVTdtYorNN4SVNl9HkHxuuB9czro_y2DbUeEM/edit, saved word for word in full-pass-2026-10-27/ANSWERS-13-27-2026-10-27.md), read 28 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward, 27 Oct 2026, answer 17: “Settings. The path is Settings → Parts → Bin Locations (S5-E2). Roles & Permissions is also under Settings (S12-R6).”
